conviction_note: Q3 is Sanoma's decisive quarter and its numbers are not pre-released (no tulosvaroitus, nothing in the Nasdaq feed since 17 Sep). A narrowing of the 2026 guide is expected and is the line the stock will trade on, so abs_move is 5.0, well above this name's own small observed reactions (Q3 2024 +1.89%, Q3 2025 -1.65%). p_up is 45: the 7-estimate consensus already has FY26 adj. EBIT at 223 against a 205-225 guide, and the stock is up 21% in three months. A routine lower-end raise (to about 215-225) would put the guide midpoint below consensus, and the only clean upside is a top-end raise. That lean is inference, so p_up stays close to 50. The findings sum (-0.3) and the scaled number (-0.5) agree in sign, and neither is fitted to the other.

new_in_release.expect: The 205-225 range is narrowed. The precedent is to raise the low end (2025: 170-190 narrowed to 180-190 at Q3, stock -1.65% that day). Consensus at 223 means a 215-225 narrowing is neutral to slightly negative, and only a raise of the top end would be a positive surprise. Direction unknown, lean slightly negative relative to the bar.
Q3 Learning high season, consensus adj. EBIT 201 vs 172.4. Unknown. The phased Spain/Italy sales and the Spain/Poland curriculum renewals have to land for it to be met.
Q3 FCF and the leverage path (net debt/adj. EBITDA 3.0 at H1 vs target <2.5). Unknown; the company guided deleveraging towards year end.
No change expected; third instalment EUR 0.14 due 10 Nov.

findings.finding: Sell-side consensus already has FY26 adj. EBIT at 223 MEUR, 99% of the top of the 205-225 guide. The expected Q3 move is to raise the low end, as in 2025 (170-190 to 180-190), and a 215-225 narrowing would set a midpoint (220) below consensus. So the anticipated guidance event can at best confirm, and only a raise of the top end beats.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025: guide narrowed upward to 180-190 against an in-line quarter, stock -1.65% (2025-10-30, observed). Q3 2024: guide narrowed upward 'as expected' with a beat, +1.89% (2024-10-30). Feb 2026 first FY26 guide of 205-225: -5.75%.
findings.original_quote: Konsensuksen mediaaniennusteet odottavat Sanomalta 1 327 MEUR:n liikevaihtoa (Inderes: 1 318 MEUR) ja 223 MEUR:n (Inderes: 220 MEUR) oikaistua liikevoittoa vuodelta 2026. ... Historiallisesti Sanoma on usein ohjeistanut konservatiivisesti ja kaventanut tulosohjeistushaarukkaa Q3:n yhteydessä nostamalla alarajaa. [Consensus median expects net sales of 1,327 MEUR and adj. EBIT of 223 MEUR for 2026 ... Historically Sanoma has often guided conservatively and narrowed the range at Q3 by raising the lower end.]
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the expectation of a narrowing is public and the stock has run +21% in three months into it. What is not obviously priced is that the routine version of the event (low end raised) lands below the 223 consensus. If the market saw that, the October run-up of about 10% on no company news would not have happened ahead of a print where only a top-end raise beats. This is inference from public numbers, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: 2025 precedent from the company's own releases: H1 2025 guide 170-190 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=bfeece4d18c788f5610ad718665593659&lang=en&src=listed) narrowed to 180-190 at Q3 2025 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b4e7f7d6d5a9977ac676d0eff138be193&lang=en&src=listed)

findings.finding: Finnish media advertising fell 1.5% y/y in September (TV -7%, print newspapers -5%, online +4%; YTD -3%). Inderes, Sanoma's covering analyst, calls this in line with forecasts, so Media Finland's Q3 ad line carries no surprise. Media Finland was 19.7 of 172.4 MEUR of Q3 2025 adj. EBIT.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Media Finland ad declines were offset by cost cuts in every 2025-26 report. The stock moved within about 2% on prints where Media was the swing line.
findings.original_quote: Suomen mediamainonnan määrä laski syyskuussa 1,5 % edellisvuodesta ... televisiomainonta supistui selvästi (- 7 %) ... findings.finding: Peer read for Sanoma's Spanish learning business (Santillana Spain plus Vicens Vives), where ~EUR 15m of sales slipped into Q3: Hachette Livre (Lagardère Publishing) reported Q3 2026 Spain accelerating (about +3%), with 'good commercial momentum in Education'.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Spain phasing was the stated reason for the flat H1 Learning EBIT. The H1 print rose +2.05% on 'on track' language.
findings.original_quote: Pendant que le Royaume-Uni, les États-Unis et l'Espagne accélèrent au troisième trimestre, la France faiblit (-4 %). ... En Espagne et en Amérique latine, l'activité profite d'une bonne dynamique commerciale, en Éducation comme en grand public. [While the UK, the US and Spain accelerate in Q3, France weakens (-4%). ... In Spain and Latin America the business benefits from good commercial momentum, in Education as in trade.]
findings.why_not_priced: It is a French trade-press item on a different company's Spanish education arm (Anaya), published 16 Oct. Nobody in the Finnish coverage cites it, and Inderes' preview does not mention a Spanish peer read. It is a narrow proxy that pools Spain with Latin America and education with trade, so it is sized small and net of the other ~85% of Learning (Netherlands, Poland, Italy, Finland, Belgium, Sweden).
findings.independence: Sanoma's own H1 statement that Spain's flagship series was renewed and the phasing would land in Q3 (https://view.news.eu.nasdaq.com/view?id=b0c482d31c03eed77eb01f93085244739&lang=en&src=listed). The same company source, so it is not independent of the bar.

baseline_tension: Mostly agrees with the small negative lean (-0.45, the run-up term). The stock is up 9% in 20 days and 21% in three months with no company news, and consensus already sits at the top of the guide. The findings point slightly negative but none is a company number the market has not seen.
language_note: The Q3 consensus table (Modular Finance, 7 estimates: Q3 adj. EBIT 201, FY 223) and the expectation of a low-end narrowing came from Inderes' Finnish-language preview of 2026-10-26. English searches returned only older Inderes English notes and no Q3 2026 consensus.
The Finnish September ad-market series (Fifty5Blue via Inderes, TV -7%) was found only in Finnish.
The Inderes retail forum (Finnish) shows investors questioning management on the 'clearly above 23%' Learning margin given a flat H1. That is sentiment, not information.
The company's own releases are bilingual on the Nasdaq feed and the Finnish versions added nothing to the English ones.
